setting.help: Define the rolling window for the historical analysis to compute the orderpoint's average daily demand and safety stock.
Select this option to ignore historical analysis's initial values up to the first non-null item.

field.name: demand_serie_skip_leading_0s
field.string: Postpone Demand History Start to 1st Move

div.span:
For example: if you sold 10 units of a product 5 days ago, and Demand History Days is set to 20, the historical analysis will yield an average of 10units / 20days = 0.5 units per day.
If this feature is active, instead, the history timerange will start from the first non-null date, which is 5 days ago, and the historical analysis will yield an average of 10units / 5days = 2 units per day.
